title: Memories UI Layout
description: The Title can go off the screen and cause layout issues like overlap. The Conflicts section is usually none, so move the lower link area to: References and Source Links first, then Conflicts only if conflicts exist. Screenshot reference: Screenshot 2026-05-25 104537.png (local account path omitted from repo task content; attach or copy a sanitized asset before PR).

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented /memories selected-detail layout fixes. The title block now uses the existing detail-title wrapper with flex sizing and overflow-wrap:anywhere, actions are isolated in a bounded action cluster, and the lower link area renders References and Source Links first with Conflicts hidden unless the selected record actually has conflicts. Validation: dotnet build .\MemorySmith.App\MemorySmith.App.csproj --nologo passed; browser probe at 520px viewport confirmed the title/actions remain within the header, overflow wrapping is active, and a no-conflict record shows only References and Source Links; route-smoke passed 6/6 against http://127.0.0.1:5099.
